descriptions.text: This contract relates to the purchase, delivery and installation of a setup to perform corrosion testing at increased pressure and temperature in a continuous process in a CO2 environment with impurities (e.g. H2O, O2, N2, NOx, SOx, H2S), relevant to CCUS applications.  This includes at least the following elements: - Delivery, installation, validation, inspection and commissioning - All necessary training.  - Electrode for corrosion research are present, and should be connectable to the setup. Dimensional drawings of the electrodes can be requested via e-mail to Arne.Simons@UGent.be   The contract is divided into the following lots:  • Lot 1: Explanation: A complete setup to allow the above-mentioned experiments, hence including: o Autoclave vessel + required heating/cooling o Autoclave lid with all required connection (2 electrodes, 1 reference electrode, gas inlet, gas outlet, thermocouple, digital/analog pressure sensor, safety features (rupture disk, spring loaded valve)) o All required pumps, piping and vessels o All required sensors  • Lot 2: Explanation: A system compatible with the currently present autoclave to allow the above-mentioned experiments, hence including: o All required pumps, piping and vessels  Lot 1 provides more flexibility to the tenderer regarding geometry and material of construction. Also, this keeps the currently existing setup intact, which will be considered during the comparison between the different proposals. On the other hand, Lot 2 offers the possibility to provide a setup at a lower cost.

Hasselt University is looking for a configurable, Erasmus without papers (EWP) compliant exchange platform to administer incoming and outgoing end-to-end exchange flows. The minimal viable product (MVP) will focus on partners/interinstitutional agreements (IIA) management, EWP compliance, student workflows (study and traineeship), notifications, templates with digital signatures, report/PowerBI connectivity, grant calculations and Single Sign-On (SSO). Subsequent phases can add deeper integrations and optional features (e.g. additional exchange programme and staff flows) subjected to year to year budget availability.   Universiteit Hasselt is op zoek naar een configureerbaar uitwisselingsplatform dat voldoet aan de "Erasmus without Papers" of "EWP"-normen, voor het beheer van inkomende en uitgaande uitwisselingsstromen van begin tot eind. Het minimaal levensvatbare product (MVP) zal zich richten op het beheer van partners/interinstitutionele overeenkomsten (IIA), EWP-conformiteit, studentenworkflows (studie en stage), meldingen, sjablonen met digitale handtekeningen, rapportage/PowerBI-connectiviteit, subsidieberekeningen en Single Sign-On (SSO). In volgende fasen kunnen diepere integraties en optionele functies (bijv. aanvullende uitwisselingsprogramma's en personeelsstromen) worden toegevoegd, afhankelijk van de jaarlijkse beschikbaarheid van budget.
